scope: Exact existing IR MPN solder lands, nominal package seating datums and optical direction; library-only correction, not a native-board release
local_evidence_scope: Diagnostic filenames are local-only, not repository links; primary sources are the manufacturer URLs and retained SHA256 values.

sources.visual_review: Full p5 package and recommended solder pad; full p6 tape view with anode and cathode marks. In tape component-side view lens points left and anode is below; rotate CW to lens-up footprint and anode becomes left.
Full p2 physical numbering; full p7 orthographic package and proposed component-side lands; full p8 TR side-view tape and p9 TT top-view tape.

sources.document: 82907, TSMP95000, Rev.1.0 20-Oct-2022; same Heimdall package drawing6.550-5297.01-4
sources.visual_review: Full p2 physical numbering, p4 package, p6 side-view tape and p7 top-view tape visually checked; TT presentation also agrees with demod p9. Pin functions1/4 GND,2 VS,3 carrier OUT remain unchanged.
Full p1 Figures1/2: side-view assembly points parallel to PCB; PCB ahead of lens can clip its aperture.

datum_conventions.footprint_origin: centre of the physical solder-land row; this is not the body/courtyard centre
datum_conventions.library_view: component-side F.Cu view, +Y down, +Z away from F.Cu
datum_conventions.body_offsets: Nominal engineering seating construction: centre the emitter1.10mm base, TR reference1.0mm foot, or TT1.2mm contact on its symmetric recommended land. The receiver pad diagram does not separately dimension land-centre-to-body registration; these offsets must not be represented as a manufacturer-guaranteed placement tolerance.
datum_conventions.body_outline: Fab rectangles conservatively bound full nominal package including lens, rather than approximate its curved surface
datum_conventions.court_margin: 0.25mm around the union of nominal body and copper lands; not a manufacturer recommended land or factory tolerance
datum_conventions.b_side_transform: KiCad Flip(LEFT_RIGHT), followed by SetOrientationDegrees; actual in-memory native transform is exercised by regression test, not a hand-written second mirror

devices.old_defect: 1.2x1.0mm lands at1.8mm pitch mistakenly copied body terminals, and body centred on solder row hid asymmetric lens extension

proposed_pose_not_applied.note: Y92 is proposed H1 ergonomic position; root must check nearby components, retained copper and optical witness placement before integration. This is anchor, not courtyard centre.

devices.old_defect: Shared TT footprint incorrectly labelled TR as top-view and centred the body on its rear solder row; current B0 does not face left

proposed_pose_not_applied.note: Y78 is proposed H1 position. Axis/numbering are proved; lens tip datum is nominal seating construction, not an independent tolerance guarantee. Check final optical aperture and board-edge stack.

devices.old_defect: Top-view TT was treated as a side-looking part; XY rotation cannot correct its out-of-plane optical axis
devices.current_risk: Looks into the inter-board gap rather than out of the agreed left edge; nearby RF PCB, parts and enclosure may obstruct it. No current unobstructed optical path has been established.
devices.unchanged_mpn_alternative_not_applied: F.Cu top-view mounting preserves30-60kHz carrier detection if the remote faces an exposed front-facing lens. It changes user aiming direction from the agreed side-edge IR bank; front panel/display/cover aperture and height must first be checked. Merely rotating it in XY is not this alternative.
devices.preferred_research_next: Check exact TSMP95000TR side-view tape as a qualified factory-placeable alternative; no MPN adoption or manual TT out-of-tape reorientation is authorised by this evidence.

integration_notes: Current native refs are U23=carrier and U24=demod; do not exchange functions using an earlier swapped verbal reference.

Root must add exact TSOP75238TR footprint override to the R2 symbol-footprint contract; the frozen historical UI footprint_for/manifest intentionally retain the previous TT hint and count. Current ir_footprint_outputs() independently emits all3 corrected library files.
No shared H2/H3 ledgers or native files were regenerated by this review; tests validate library generation and in-memory optical rotations only.
Changing IR optical direction can invalidate the internal emitter witness placement; the witness optomechanics is a separate integration check, not covered here.
